Class ImportJobRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.sebastiandorata.musicdashboard.service.Import.ImportJobRegistry
@Component public class ImportJobRegistry extends Object
In-memory registry of import jobs so the browser can poll the progress of a running import.

Each scan or upload creates a ImportJobRegistry.Job with a random id and the id of the user who started it. The job doubles as the ImportOrchestrator.ImportCallbacks handed to ImportOrchestrator: the import-pipeline thread updates it while HTTP request threads read it through snapshot(String, Long). A job is only ever returned to its owner, and finished jobs are dropped after RETENTION so the map cannot grow forever.

SRP: only tracks job state; it never touches files or the database.

Space Complexity: O(J + R) for J live jobs and R result rows they hold.
